status: PROVISIONAL — awaiting ratification poll. Phase state: see ROADMAP.md
spinup_note: Spun up 2026-10-01 from the Culture handoff packet (docs/handoff/); packet open questions polled alongside the 9 survey questions.

survey.what_is_it: library/engine + app — libculture (pure C++20 deterministic CA core), a headless trace CLI, and one native macOS viewer with ambient sonification. Other form factors (plugin, FOUNDATIONS module) may wrap the core later; not composite now.

architecture_rung.earned_by: the port is serial and fully specified; read-only subagents for SPEC/JS cross-checks and an independent verifier on parity claims earn their keep. No parallel writers; core/audio/app seams not yet frozen enough to justify a fleet.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: simulation core (world step, mulberry32 RNG and its call order, rule screening and search, territory, surprise, float32 storage semantics), the trace format, and the sonification mapping/DSP math. AI may propose code; golden traces and bit-reproducible offline audio renders decide. No wall-clock time in core/.

oracle_shape.goldens: strict bit-exact: golden/*.jsonl from the JS reference via tools/compare.js — integer state exact, only record/lastMax carry compare.js's relative tolerance. Goldens change only by a recorded DECISIONS entry.
oracle_shape.ci: single-platform smoke (Linux, Node + C++ core); macOS app builds stay local

second_implementation.shape: port-pin: reference/core.js is the pinned oracle; the C++ core must match the goldens. Phase 4 records which implementation becomes canonical.

consumers_and_providers.note: standalone for now; a Reverb Station or FOUNDATIONS intake brief is a later, recorded decision

lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: interactive: attended sessions; own-branch push + PR are the agent's, merging is the human's; no unattended runs

packet_questions.platforms: macOS first (Apple Silicon, Command Line Tools only); core + trace CLI portable C++20; Vision Pro deferred
packet_questions.rendering_stack: DEFERRED to the phase-2 gate (spike then decide)
packet_questions.audio_stack: DEFERRED to the phase-3 gate, incl. whether Reverb Station's FDN replaces convolution reverb
packet_questions.parity_strictness: bit-exact is a hard phase-1 gate
packet_questions.search_timing: deterministic latency, L = 30 generations, for live play; instant mode always available for verification
packet_questions.packet_disposition: reference/, tools/, golden/ copied unchanged to repo root; packet docs in docs/handoff/; the original culture-handoff/ and Culture.html kept on disk, gitignored
